description: The most relevant number of the problem "black-box AI" of the start page ranking and the potential solution. The concept paper section 6 documents an AI that called the 99 percent initiative an open distributional question although the initiative had already been rejected in 2021 with 64.9 percent no votes and not a single accepting canton. The solution is to organise AI systems with societal decision relevance as a public good.

triples.name: black-box AI
triples.description: proprietary AI systems without disclosed training data, open source code or accountability chain, which reproduce a text in its intended reading instead of exposing its weaknesses (concept paper section 6)

triples.name: public AI
triples.description: AI systems with societal decision relevance organised as a public good with disclosed training data, open source availability and clear liability rules (concept paper section 6)

sources.name: Zueger & Asghari (2025) public interest AI
sources.description: Zueger, T. & Asghari, H. (2025): The landscape of public-interest-oriented AI. Digital Society Blog, Alexander von Humboldt Institute for Internet and Society.

sources.name: Swiss Federal Chancellery, popular vote of 26 September 2021
sources.description: Official result of the Swiss popular vote of 26 September 2021 on the "99 percent initiative": rejected with 64.9 percent no votes and by every canton.
